must_preserve: Separate habitat volume, standing abundance, composition, functional potential, and realized activity.
Do not claim collected samples, observed rates, a global numerical census, or extraterrestrial-life detection.
Do not add acknowledgements, funding statements, author biographies, or unrelated page-filling material.
Keep uncertainty direct and bounded, rather than using generic disclaimers.
human_review_items: Refresh official publisher metadata and any data-access requirements after the in-app browser connection is restored.
Review low-biomass contamination controls and pressure-preservation procedures with deep-sea operators.
Review hierarchical model priors, spatial support, and flux integration with geobiogeochemistry and statistics experts.
